textPreview.method: Headless Chrome with the actual bundled viewer and both Monaco editors under the webview content-security policy. Node tests separately check decoded values and field-path lookup.

benchmark.conditions: Generated file with repeated small records and a warm filesystem cache. Index timing includes worker startup. Selection timing measures worker replies and excludes UI rendering.

extensionHost.method: Installed VS Code extension test runner in an isolated temporary profile, with passive observation of the actual webview message bridge.

monacoViewer.method: Headless Chrome serving the packaged webview assets with the same content-security policy, actual Monaco JSON and editor workers, and a temporary host bridge. Extension activation and the row message bridge were also checked in VS Code.

webview.method: Headless Chrome with the actual HTML, CSS and JavaScript assets. A temporary host bridge used the actual file worker and indexed-file implementation.
